## Source
.design/m5/46-ozone-migration.md — REQ-1, REQ-2 + decomposition PR 1.

## Surface
- New workspace member: `polaris-ozone-import/`
- New files:
  - `src/source/mod.rs` — re-exports
  - `src/source/moderation_subject_status.rs` — `OzoneSubjectStatusRow` struct + `read_all()`/`stream_all()`
  - `src/source/moderation_event.rs` — `OzoneModerationEventRow` struct + `read_all()`/`stream_all()`
- Test: `tests/source_readers.rs` — reads fixture dump (created in #142), asserts row-by-row equality

## Rust-quality notes
- Source structs are `#[derive(Debug, Clone, sqlx::FromRow, serde::Deserialize)]`. Fields named EXACTLY as Ozone's columns (Rust snake_case maps to Postgres lowercase by default).
- **`sqlx::query_as!` with the `--offline` cache against an Ozone reference schema.** The reference schema is checked into `polaris-ozone-import/ozone-schema/v0.X.sql` and the sqlx offline cache regenerates against it.
- **Streaming reader**: `pub fn stream_subject_statuses(pool: &PgPool) -> impl Stream<Item = Result<OzoneSubjectStatusRow, SourceError>>` so the migration can process row-by-row without loading the entire Ozone DB into memory. Per rust-quality §6.
- **`SourceError` is `thiserror`** with variants `RowDecodeFailed { source_table, source_row_id, source: sqlx::Error }`, `ConnectionFailed(#[from] sqlx::Error)`, `SchemaVersionMismatch { found, supported }`.
- Per rust-quality §3 (binary crate, but library-internal): no `unwrap` even in fixture reads.

## External references
- Ozone schema source: https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto/tree/main/packages/ozone/src/db/schema
- sqlx streams: https://docs.rs/sqlx/latest/sqlx/postgres/types/index.html
- `futures::stream::TryStream`: https://docs.rs/futures/latest/futures/stream/trait.TryStreamExt.html

## Acceptance
- [ ] `cargo test -p polaris-ozone-import --test source_readers` passes against fixture.
- [ ] Streaming reader can process a 1M-row fixture without exceeding 128MB peak memory.

- Blocks #136 (mapping consumes the source types).
